lines.text: Many learners say: It depends you.
Depends on! It depends on you.

native.tip: Kita bilang “Tergantung kamu” tanpa kata tambahan, tapi bahasa Inggris butuh on: depends on.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “It depends you.” 😅 Setelah depends, tambahkan on: “It depends on you.” Dengarkan Kak Ama, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “depends on”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “It depends on you.” Lalu ganti you dengan the weather. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “Tergantung kamu” with no extra word, but English needs on: depends on.
en.caption: Ever say this? “It depends you.” 😅 After depends, add on: “It depends on you.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
